compile_order.why: script rule drifted when moved mid-brief (LAB2)

compile_order.source: Campaign goal + OutcomeDefinition, written as shapes
code shape: value-first; first turn checks the name only
code; backup only, enforcement is the reply door
Offering facts + contact variables, key:value, delimited data block

tail_per_turn.source: code, pure function of transcript + LedgerPack

brief_schema.budget_rule: count UTF-8 bytes per section after escaping; any section over cap throws at compile and blocks publish naming the section; never slice (HV law 4)
brief_schema.measured_reference: lab renewal brief v2 compiled core 7,345 bytes, tail 869 bytes (computed 2026-10-21 from PV2 compile_prompt/tail with memory, notes and sounds on)
brief_schema.cache_rule: SCRIPT..SAFETY are byte-stable per Version and sent first; MEMORY_BRIEF and FACTS_ROWS vary per contact; tail varies per turn (HV law 6). Read cached-token counts off real responses.

register_defaults.address: aap with plural verb forms, unless the contact's memory says otherwise
register_defaults.agent_gender_forms: feminine by default; must match the chosen voice

warmth.collections: low-warm, no humour, no sound tags

register_defaults.length: most turns one short sentence; up to three when information is asked or the caller is worried or confused
register_defaults.questions: most turns none; max one per turn; never two question endings in a row
register_defaults.goal_steps: max one per turn; never on two turns running
register_defaults.laugh_cap: no laugh within 3 turns of the last; at most 2 per call
register_defaults.sound_tags: Gemini voices only; max one per reply; stripped for every other voice

lint_rules.rule: quoted sentence or first-person line inside any shape field
lint_rules.why: quotes recited 4/5 to 0 after removal (HV law 2)

lint_rules.rule: bracketed stage direction or 'say in a ... tone' text anywhere that can reach TTS
lint_rules.why: Gemini TTS spoke the style prefix (rejected.2026-10-20.gemini-tts-style-prefix); brackets spoken in 4/4 (TXV)

lint_rules.rule: number, price, date or percentage written in prose instead of FACTS_ROWS
named-feeling empathy labels ('I understand', 'that must be frustrating')
lint_rules.why: stock phrases 1.8-2.7 per call in v1 (LAB2)

lint_rules.rule: more than 3 instructions that ask her to ask questions
a must-fire rule placed outside the tail
client text that removes or contradicts the AI disclosure, crisis lines, or the no-OTP rule
lint_rules.why: disclosure non-removable on every creation path (decision.2026-10-21.wt-synthesis-must-be-changes)

ledger_pack.derived_at: publish, by the Brief writer agent (LLM-assisted), then frozen into the Version and reviewed by the client as 'What she tracks'

contents.told: one pattern set per fact row (Devanagari, Latin, digits)
contents.offers: one pattern set per next step in the agenda
contents.numbers: set of every number in FACTS_ROWS and contact variables, canonicalised
contents.lexicons: NO / YES / CLOSING / CUES per language mode (seed: PV2)

ledger_pack.validation: Test pilot labels synthetic transcripts; each told/offer pattern needs precision >= 0.95 and recall >= 0.9 on its keys or publish is blocked with the failing row
ledger_pack.runtime: deterministic; no model call on the turn path

Standard.short_answer_fast_path: if her last turn was a yes/no question or offer and the caller's final is a single answer token, release at once
Standard.quiet_reply_rescue: VAD segment 200-700 ms with no final within 900 ms after her question -> gated short check from the acknowledgement bank, never two turns running

Patient.use_for: elderly or slow speakers; auto-suggested when in-call pace is slow or memory says so
Patient.continuer: gated 'जी' / 'हाँ जी' from the acknowledgement bank at 2,000 ms of VAD speech with no final, never two turns running
Patient.target: no cut-in on the 2.4 s elderly mid-sentence pause in >= 10/12 battery turns (every VP stack took it 12/12 today, L8R2)

Brisk.use_for: busy professionals; auto-suggested when the ledger reads 'in a hurry'

turn_presets.lab_reference: lab policy: release on latest final or 1.2 s silence; 1,400 ms hold on continuation words; withdraw at 250 ms; barge-in 300 ms + 2 words or 700 ms (CALLS _tick). Result: 15-42% cut-ins, elderly 2.4 s pause taken 12/12 (L8R2).

completeness_cues.punctuation: trailing comma, ellipsis or dash = incomplete; question mark after a question word = complete
completeness_cues.basis: Hindi is verb-final, so an ending on a postposition or conjunction signals an unfinished thought [I]; continuation list from CALLS CUES [O]. Must be measured on the battery before it ships as default.

context_dependent.ठीक है / theek hai / ok: acknowledgement while she explains; an answer (yield after the current clause) when her current clause is a question or an offer

lexicons.never_discard_rule: every short final heard over her is classified (acknowledgement | stop | answer/objection | unknown) and logged; none is dropped. Bolna discards finals of 1 word or fewer not on an English stop list (research/2026-10-20/account-phase/bolna/report.md s1.3).
lexicons.version_rule: lexicons are versioned data, editable per agent, shipped as defaults per language mode; the version is written into the run manifest

acknowledgement_bank.what: short tokens (जी, हाँ, अच्छा, हम्म, ओके) pre-rendered in the agent's own voice and style at publish
acknowledgement_bank.phase: v1 for quiet-reply rescue and the Patient continuer; acknowledgement-first rendering of reply openers in v2
uses: first word of a reply when the brain's first clause is one of these tokens (no TTS wait for it)
acknowledgement_bank.gates: never two turns running; never while echo hold is active; never as a static filler on every turn (HV/TXV: a static 'hmm' list became a tic)
acknowledgement_bank.why_own_voice: a synthesised 'mm' in another timbre was rejected by ear (docs/harvest/hp-main.md)
acknowledgement_bank.metric_rule: reply gap is reported to the first content word; first sound is reported separately

order: R1 strip: tone notes, brackets, unknown tags, end-call marker; keep sound tags only for voices that support them

R2 disclosure present: the introduction turn must carry the light AI line; if missing, the door appends the Brand's approved disclosure clause (code-owned text, 3 approved variants per language, never removable)

R3 never denied: a clause that claims or implies being human is replaced by the approved honest clause; classifier tuned on keys because a naive gate misread 'मैं human advisor...' (L8R2 gate false positives 14/60 on one config)
R4 disclosure not repeated: an unprompted second disclosure clause is dropped (21% of round-1 turns restated it, LAB2)
R5 crisis: caller-side crisis detector suspends the goal, forces the crisis shape with Tele-MANAS 14416 and 112, alerts the Supervisor; she never ends a crisis call first

R6 numbers from data: every amount, date, time and percent must match FACTS_ROWS, contact variables or numbers confirmed earlier in this call, after canonicalising lakh, hazaar, Devanagari digits and times; else the clause becomes the approved 'a colleague will confirm' clause and an Issue is logged
R7 promotion fence: on a service-category call, clauses matching the Offering never-say list or the promotional classifier are blocked
R8 no OTP, PIN, card, CVV, bank-detail or payment ask; payment only as a link on the client's domain via follow-up
R9 no internals: no vendor or model names
R10 monologue guard: a reply is cut at the clause boundary after 60 words
R11 hang-up guard: end honoured only if her line is a goodbye and the caller's last turn was not a question; audio finishes, 1.5 s beat, cancelled if the caller speaks
reply_door.lookahead: one clause of lookahead before TTS (TXV agent lane)

silence_and_limits.silence_ladder: nudge in the caller's language (short, warm, not 'are you still there'), second nudge offering a better time, then a polite close and a callback scheduled inside window and budget
silence_and_limits.near_limit: at max minus 45 s the ledger adds a row to start closing; at max she closes with one warm line

operator_and_voicemail.goal: classify switched-off, not-reachable, busy, invalid number, voicemail and IVR within 4 s median, with a reason code, and bill the fewest seconds
operator_and_voicemail.method: STT phrase match plus an acoustic fingerprint of recorded carrier announcements (they are fixed recordings); first 6 s only; 'haan', 'hello', 'boliye' within the window = human

default_actions.voicemail: hang up, no message (configurable: short message naming the company)
default_actions.operator_message: end, reason code, retry per campaign ladder

operator_and_voicemail.contrast: Bolna waits for 7+ words, checks every 7 s up to 30 s, billed, no Hindi operator messages (research/2026-10-20/account-phase/bolna/report.md)
operator_and_voicemail.status: untested (plan T4); needs a call lab

signals: speech rate from STT word timings
loudness vs the call's own baseline
person_reading.validation: classified against synthetic callers with known hidden states; never graded by the model that produced it (HV law 9)

predicted_gap.formula: ears final lag p50 (for ears + segmentation) + expected hold (P(unsure) x unsure hold + P(incomplete) x incomplete hold) + brain first token p50 (model + region) + first clause time + voice first audio p50 + leading silence + phone leg

predicted_gap.display: stacked bar in ms next to the measured India p50 with n and date, or 'not measured'
